items.raw_excerpt: Explore the struggles and resilience of parents with differently abled children in Kerala, highlighting their search for support and hope.

items.raw_excerpt: El hecho ocurrió en la Autopista Interportuaria, que une Concepción, Penco y Talcahuano. La concesionaria se disculpó y hará una revisión de sus protocolos ante este tipo de situaciones.
items.summary_en: A woman went into labor on the Interportuaria highway in Chile's Biobío region. A toll booth worker would not let her pass because she had no cash on hand. The toll company apologized and said it will review its protocols for emergency situations.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 비오비오주에서 한 여성이 분만이 시작되자 고속도로 갓길에서 출산해야 했다. 요금소 직원이 현금이 없다는 이유로 통행을 허용하지 않았기 때문이다. 해당 요금소 운영사는 사과하고 비상 상황 대응 점검을 진행하겠다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Woman gave birth on highway shoulder after toll worker blocked her for having no cash

items.raw_excerpt: Explore Madras Day 2026, celebrating Chennai's unique Madras bashai, a vibrant dialect shaped by diverse linguistic influences.
items.summary_en: Madras Day 2026 celebrates Chennai's unique Madras bashai dialect. The vibrant local language was shaped by many different influences over time. The festival honors the city's tradition of welcoming new words into its vocabulary.
items.summary_ko: 마드라스 데이 2026은 첸나이 고유의 마드라스 바샤이 방언을 기념합니다. 이 생생한 지역 언어는 다양한 언어적 영향을 받으며 형성되었습니다. 축제는 새로운 단어를 환영하는 도시의 전통을 선보입니다.
items.title_en: Chennai celebrates Madras Day with local dialect

items.raw_excerpt: Discover Chennai's vibrant coastline, a free open-air arena offering endless entertainment for all ages this Madras Day 2026.
items.summary_en: Chennai's lively coastline is being called the biggest free open-air arena for entertainment. The city celebrates Madras Day 2026 by highlighting its beaches as a place for all ages to enjoy. Visitors can explore food, music, and community events along the shore.
items.summary_ko: 첸나이의 활기찬 해안선이 가장 큰 무료 야외 엔터테인먼트 장소로 주목받고 있다. 시는 마드라스 데이 2026을 맞아 해변을 모든 연령대가 즐길 수 있는 공간으로 소개하고 있다. 방문객들은 해변을 따라 음식과 음악, 지역 행사를 즐길 수 있다.
items.title_en: Chennai's coast is a free open-air arena for everyone

items.raw_excerpt: Da Redação – Os candidatos ao Governo de Pernambuco cumprem agendas no Recife, na Região Metropolitana e no interior do estado nesta sexta-feira (28). Raquel Lyra (PSD) participa de um congresso em Gravatá e de uma caminhada em Jaboatão dos Guararapes. João Campos (PSB) concentra os compromissos na capital, enquanto Ivan Moraes (PSOL) passa por […]
items.summary_en: Three candidates for governor of Pernambuco held campaign events on Friday. Raquel Lyra visited Gravata and Jaboatao dos Guararapes, while Joao Campos stayed in the capital Recife. Ivan Moraes toured towns in the interior of the state.
items.summary_ko: 페르남부쿠 주지사 선거 후보 셋이 금요일 각각 다른 지역에서 선거 운동을 펼친다. 라켈 리라는 그라바타와 자보아탄 도스구아라라피스를 방문하고, 조앙 카무스는 수도 레시피에 집중한다. 이반 모라에스는 주 내륙 도시들을 순회한다.
items.title_en: Pernambuco candidates campaign in Recife and nearby towns

items.raw_excerpt: Travellers will be able to fly directly between Valencia or Ibiza to New York from next summer.
items.summary_en: Travelers will soon be able to fly directly from New York to Valencia and Ibiza in Spain. The new routes launch next summer and connect the US with two popular Spanish destinations.

items.raw_excerpt: Danish party proposes 30,000 kroner fee for parking in Copenhagen, Parliament votes through compensation in Greenland IUD scandal, and other news from Denmark on Friday.
items.summary_en: A Danish political party wants to charge 30,000 kroner for parking in Copenhagen. The proposal aims to reduce traffic and support green transport in the city.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu establishes three new elephant corridors to enhance migration and conservation of elephants between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
items.summary_en: Tamil Nadu has established three new elephant corridors to help elephants migrate safely between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. The corridors are designed to improve wildlife conservation and protect elephant populations in the region.
